english.notes:
(i) Section 13(1) of the of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides that the any equipment in respect of which the offence was committed shall be liable to be forfeited.
Section 83 of the Weights and Measures Act 1985 provides:-
83(1) In England and Wales, proceedings for any offence under this Act or any instrument made under this Act. shall not be instituted except by or on behalf of a local weights and measures authority or the chief officer of police for a police area.
